### [`new_game_players`](../../../../src/status/players.asm#L6) `$8ADD`

*routine*

Starts a new game: player 1, three lives, score 0 for both players. Loads the best score of player 1.

### [`end_turn`](../../../../src/status/players.asm#L33) `$8B05`

*routine*
